info.title: Wings Git Manager API
info.description: Git repository management, automated version control, AI session tracking, backup and recovery for Wings Code. Authenticate with 'Authorization: Bearer wgm_…' (scoped API token) or an OIDC access token. Send Idempotency-Key on retried mutations.

post.summary: Create (or idempotently return) the repository for a Wings Code project

delete.summary: Remove from Wings (remote archived; purging the remote requires a system administrator and a verified backup)

post.summary: Import an existing Git repository (local path or remote URL) without losing history
Clone the central repository into a new authorized directory (asynchronous job)

get.summary: Uncommitted changes (no from/to) or the diff between two revisions

post.summary: Before modifying code: policy evaluation, pre-change checkpoint, workspace lease
After modifying code: stage the operation's files, scan, commit, push and verify
Controlled merge with conflict detection (dryRun supported; approval when policy requires)
Dry run: current vs recovery commit, affected files, conflicts, strategy and expected result
Recover a deleted local project from the central repository (asynchronous job)
Conversational recovery: interpret a request and return ranked recovery points
Start an AI coding session (isolated worktree + session branch by default)
Interpret a natural-language recovery request (no repository access)

bearer.description: API token (wgm_…) or OIDC access token
